intro: Lethlor Ravine is a jagged, rocky canyon winding through the eastern reaches of the Badlands. It serves as a perilous roost and breeding ground for the black dragonflight, swarming with aggressive whelps and mature drakes.

p: Carved deep into the scorched plateaus of the eastern Badlands, Lethlor Ravine is one of the most hazardous stretches of the desert. The craggy canyon walls provide a natural aerie for the black dragonflight, housing nests of fierce dragon whelps guarded by larger, fire-breathing drakes. Few travelers dare approach the valley floor, as the shadows overhead constantly betray the flight of winged predators circling among the rocky spires.

Beyond the scaly brood that claims it, Lethlor Ravine is marked by curious crystalline obelisks scattered throughout the crags. These crystalline formations are involved in a local quest chain. Their origin is not established.
